facts.statement: Issi is a plateosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Triassic in Greenland.
facts.quote: Issi (meaning "cold" in Greenlandic) is a plateosaurid dinosaur from the Late Triassic Fleming Fjord Formation of Greenland.

facts.statement: The only known species is Issi saaneq, which translates to "cold bone".
facts.quote: It contains one species, Issi saaneq; the full binomial name means "cold bone".

facts.statement: Issi is the first non-avian dinosaur species described from Greenland.
facts.quote: This taxon is the first non-avian dinosaur described from Greenland.

facts.statement: A skull of a basal sauropodomorph was uncovered on July 27, 1991, by a Harvard University team led by Farish Jenkins on Jameson Land in Greenland.
facts.quote: On 27 July 1991, at the east coast of Greenland, on Jameson Land, in the Iron Cake site on the northern slope of the MacKnight Bjerg near the Flemingfjord, by William W. Amaral, William R. Downs, Stephen M. Gatesy, Neil H. Shubin and Niels Bonde, members of a team from Harvard University headed by Farish Jenkins, a skull was uncovered of a basal sauropodomorph.

facts.statement: The species Issi saaneq was named and described in 2021 by Victor Beccari Dieguez Campo, Octávio Mateus, Oliver Wings, Jesper Milàn, and Lars Bjørn Clemmensen.
facts.quote: In 2021, the type species Issi saaneq was named and described by Victor Beccari Dieguez Campo, Octávio Mateus, Oliver Wings, Jesper Milàn and Lars Bjørn Clemmensen.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen was found in the Malmros Klint Formation, which dates to the middle Norian stage.
facts.quote: The holotype, NHMD 164741, was found in a layer of the Malmros Klint Formation of the Fleming Fjord Group, dating from the middle Norian.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a relatively complete skull, lower jaws, and teeth.
facts.quote: It consists of a relatively complete skull with lower jaws and teeth.

facts.statement: The skull of the holotype is partly articulated.
facts.quote: The skull is partly articulated.

facts.statement: The holotype represents a later-stage juvenile or subadult individual.
facts.quote: It represents a later stage juvenile or subadult individual.

facts.statement: The preserved length of the holotype skull is 243.7 millimetres.
facts.quote: The skull of the holotype of Issi has a preserved length of 243.7 millimetres.

facts.statement: In 2021, Issi was reinterpreted as a distinct genus that is the sister species of Plateosaurus.
facts.quote: However, in 2021 they were reinterpreted as belonging to a distinct genus, the sister species of Plateosaurus.

facts.statement: Issi is classified within the family Plateosauridae.
facts.quote: familia: Plateosauridae

facts.statement: Issi lived approximately 214 million years ago during the Norian stage of the Late Triassic in what is now Europe.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Triásico, hace aproximadamnete 214 millones de años, durante el Noriense, en lo que es hoy Europa.

facts.statement: A basal sauropodomorph skull was discovered on July 27, 1991, at the Iron Cake site in northeastern Greenland.
facts.quote: El 27 de julio de 1991, en la costa este de Groenlandia, en la Tierra de Jameson, en el sitio de Iron Cake en la ladera norte del MacKnight Bjerg cerca del Flemingfjord, se descubrió un cráneo de un sauropodomorfo basal

facts.statement: In 1994, the discovery was reported in scientific literature and initially assigned to Plateosaurus engelhardti.
facts.quote: En 1994, el hallazgo se informó en la literatura científica y se refirió a Plateosaurus engelhardti.

facts.statement: A smaller juvenile skull was discovered in 1995.
facts.quote: En 1995, se descubrió el cráneo de un animal juvenil más pequeño.

facts.statement: Three additional skeletons were excavated in 2012.
facts.quote: En 2012, se excavaron tres esqueletos adicionales.

facts.statement: The holotype, NHMD 164741, was found in the Middle Norian-age Malmros Klint Formation.
facts.quote: El holotipo, NHMD 164741, se encontró en una capa de la Formación Malmros Klint que data del Noriense medio.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a relatively complete skull with lower jaws and teeth.
facts.quote: Consiste en un cráneo relativamente completo con mandíbulas y dientes inferiores.

facts.statement: The holotype represents a late-stage juvenile or subadult individual.
facts.quote: Representa un individuo juvenil o subadulto en una etapa posterior.

facts.statement: The paratype is specimen NHMD 164758, found in 1995 in the same layer.
facts.quote: El paratipo es el espécimen NHMD 164758, encontrado en 1995 en la misma capa.

facts.statement: The paratype consists of a skull with lower jaws that is more complete than the holotype.
facts.quote: Consiste en un cráneo con mandíbulas inferiores, más completo que el holotipo.

facts.statement: The paratype is missing only the back-right corner of the skull roof.
facts.quote: Solo le falta la esquina trasera derecha del techo del cráneo.

facts.statement: The paratype represents a mid-stage juvenile, approximately one-third shorter than the holotype.
facts.quote: Representa un juvenil de etapa media, aproximadamente un tercio más corto que el holotipo.

facts.statement: Three skeletons discovered in 2012 (specimens NHMD 164734, GM.V 2013-683, and NHMD 164775) were not formally referred to or described in 2021.
facts.quote: Los tres esqueletos descubiertos en 2012, los especímenes NHMD 164734, GM.V 2013‐683 y NHMD 164775, en 2021 no estaban formalmente referidos ni descritos.

facts.statement: Because the last skeleton was not fully prepared, the description was limited to the head.
facts.quote: El último esqueleto aún no estaba completamente preparado. Esto limitó la descripción a la cabeza.

facts.statement: The holotype and referred specimens were originally assigned to the species Plateosaurus trossingensis.
facts.quote: El holotipo y los especímenes referidos, NHMD 164758 y NHMD 164751, fueron asignados originalmente a la especie Plateosaurus trossingensis.

facts.statement: In 2021, they were reinterpreted as their own genus but remain closely related to Plateosaurus.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, en 2021 fueron reinterpretados como su propio género, pero aún estrechamente relacionados con Plateosaurus.

facts.statement: Issi belongs to the parent group Plateosauridae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Plateosauridae

facts.statement: Issi is classified in the family Plateosauridae.
facts.quote: Family: Plateosauridae

facts.statement: Issi is classified in the class Saurischia.
facts.quote: Class: Saurischia

facts.statement: Issi lived during the Norian stage, from 227.3 to 205.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Norian to Norian (227.3 to 205.7 million years ago)
